data: You stimulate your brain with nasty thoughts. For the duration, you have advantage on any attacks with the Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma move power. If the attack requires a Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma saving throw, the target has disadvantage.
Gets the Pokémon pumped up. Helps prevent nervousness, too.
Doubles the Appeal Points of a successful move in the next round. Pokemon also has advantage on CHA Saving Throws until after their move next round is performed.
